During a Hold Up, you will be able to[n]threaten enemy Shadows.
This lets you recruit enemy Shadows[n]to be your Personas. You can also[n]acquire items and important info.
Threatening an enemy may not always[n]succeed. Analyze the enemy's responses[n]and choose yours wisely.
You can also freely change the Personas[n]you have obtained.
When you change Personas, your stats[n]and resistances will change to match[n]the Persona you selected.
